questions.stemEn: A neonate did not pass meconium and has abdominal distension. A barium study image shows a small left colon. Which newborn condition is associated with this presentation?
questions.explanationAr: الصورة والوصف يتماشيان مع small left colon syndrome، وهو transient functional obstruction يرتبط بشكل كلاسيكي بكون الطفل Infant of diabetic mother. الـcontrast enema يُظهر contracted left colon وقد تتحسن الحالة تلقائيًا خلال أيام. المصدر يذكر ضرورة الانتباه للتفريق عن Hirschsprung disease.
questions.reasoningEn: The compilation associates small left colon syndrome with infants of diabetic mothers and describes transient left-colon dysmotility on contrast enema.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Down syndrome يرتبط أكثر بـduodenal atresia وHirschsprung disease؛ PUV ليس سببًا لهذه صورة القولون؛ CF قد يسبب meconium ileus لكنه ليس الارتباط المذكور هنا؛ prematurity ليست الإجابة المختبرة في هذا السؤال.
questions.clinicalPearl: Small left colon syndrome: think infant of diabetic mother; contrast enema is diagnostic and may also be therapeutic.
diagnosticSteps: Consider rectal biopsy if Hirschsprung disease remains a concern

questions.stemEn: A child passes hard stool once per week and has fecal incontinence. Otherwise everything is normal and there are no alarm signs. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanationAr: Hard, infrequent stools مع fecal incontinence وغياب red flags تتماشى مع functional constipation. الـfecal incontinence هنا قد تكون overflow بسبب احتباس كتلة برازية كبيرة وتمدد المستقيم.
questions.reasoningEn: The source describes large hard painful stools, withholding, and overflow fecal incontinence as hallmarks of functional constipation.
questions.clinicalPearl: Overflow fecal incontinence can occur in chronic functional constipation.

tts.text: A child passes hard stool once per week and has fecal incontinence. Otherwise everything is normal and there are no alarm signs. What is the most likely diagnosis? A. Functional constipation.

questions.stemEn: An 8-year-old child has constipation and an X-ray suggestive of functional constipation. What are you expecting to find during digital anorectal examination?
questions.explanationAr: في functional constipation غالبًا يكون rectum متوسعًا وممتلئًا بالبراز. المصدر يقارن ذلك مع Hirschsprung disease حيث قد تجد tight anal canal وempty ampulla وقد يحدث squirt/blast sign بعد الفحص.
questions.reasoningEn: A distended rectum full of stool supports functional constipation; an empty ampulla with a tight anal canal is more suggestive of Hirschsprung disease.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: الخيارات التي تشير إلى abnormal anal anatomy أو عدم ارتخاء المصرة ليست النمط المتوقع المعتاد في functional constipation بحسب المصدر.
questions.clinicalPearl: Functional constipation: rectum often full of stool; Hirschsprung: tight canal with empty ampulla.
diagnosticSteps: Digital anorectal examination when clinically indicated

questions.topic: Celiac Disease and Other Malabsorption Syndromes
questions.stemEn: A 2-year-old boy presents with abdominal distension and pallor that did not improve with iron supplementation. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanationAr: Abdominal distension مع iron-deficiency-type pallor غير المستجيب للحديد يرفع الشك في malabsorption، والمصدر يختبر celiac disease. قد تظهر celiac disease بأعراض GI أو extraintestinal مثل iron deficiency وتأخر النمو.
questions.reasoningEn: The compilation highlights abdominal distension plus iron deficiency that does not improve with supplementation as a celiac disease clue.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Hookworm وGiardiasis قد يسببان أعراضًا معوية أو سوء تغذية، لكن النمط المختبر في المصدر هو celiac disease مع iron deficiency غير المستجيب.
questions.clinicalPearl: Unexplained or refractory iron deficiency can be an extraintestinal presentation of celiac disease.
diagnosticSteps: Celiac serology while the child is consuming gluten

questions.topic: Celiac Disease and Other Malabsorption Syndromes
questions.stemEn: A child with failure to thrive has abdominal pain, diarrhea, anemia, and a skin rash shown as dermatitis herpetiformis. Which test do you want to order?
questions.explanationAr: Dermatitis herpetiformis هي skin manifestation مرتبطة بقوة بـceliac disease. وجود FTT + diarrhea + anemia يجعل celiac serology هي الاختبار الذي يستهدف التشخيص مباشرة بحسب السؤال.
questions.reasoningEn: Dermatitis herpetiformis is strongly associated with gluten-sensitive enteropathy; the source selects celiac serology.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Fecal calprotectin يفيد أكثر عند الشك في intestinal inflammation/IBD؛ sweat chloride لـCF؛ TSH لا يفسر rash الكلاسيكي؛ total serum IgA مهم لتفسير بعض celiac serology tests لكنه ليس الاختيار التشخيصي المباشر المطروح هنا.
questions.clinicalPearl: Dermatitis herpetiformis should trigger evaluation for celiac disease.

questions.topic: Celiac Disease and Other Malabsorption Syndromes
questions.stemEn: An infant has persistent watery diarrhea. You are considering congenital chloride diarrhea versus osmotic diarrhea. What study will help make the diagnosis?
questions.explanationAr: Stool electrolytes تسمح بحساب stool osmotic gap وقياس fecal chloride/sodium، وبالتالي تساعد في التفريق بين secretory congenital diarrheas وبين osmotic diarrhea.
questions.reasoningEn: The source selects stool electrolytes to distinguish congenital chloride diarrhea from osmotic diarrhea.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Urine electrolytes لا تحدد نوع الإسهال مباشرة، وsweat chloride موجه أساسًا لتقييم cystic fibrosis.
questions.clinicalPearl: Fecal electrolyte concentrations are central to evaluating congenital secretory diarrhea.
diagnosticSteps: Measure stool sodium, potassium, and chloride
Calculate stool osmotic gap when appropriate

questions.topic: Celiac Disease and Other Malabsorption Syndromes
questions.stemEn: An infant with failure to thrive has persistent watery diarrhea. Labs show low sodium, low potassium, chloride 87, pH 7.48, and bicarbonate 30. Antenatal ultrasound showed dilated bowel loops. What study will help make the diagnosis?
questions.explanationAr: Antenatal dilated bowel loops مع persistent watery diarrhea وhypochloremic, hypokalemic metabolic alkalosis هي clues قوية لـcongenital chloride diarrhea. المصدر يذكر أن fecal chloride يكون >90 mmol/L ويُقاس عبر stool electrolytes.
questions.reasoningEn: The source describes the classic prenatal and biochemical pattern of congenital chloride diarrhea and recommends stool electrolyte measurement.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Urine electrolytes قد تعكس secondary renal response لكنها لا تؤكد fecal chloride loss؛ sweat chloride يفيد في CF وليس هذا النمط الكلاسيكي.
questions.clinicalPearl: Congenital chloride diarrhea: fecal chloride >90 mmol/L and metabolic alkalosis.

questions.stemEn: A 2-year-old child presents to the emergency department with acute gastroenteritis and mild dehydration. What is the best next step?

options.text: Give ORS and an age-appropriate diet

questions.explanationAr: في mild dehydration بسبب acute gastroenteritis، المصدر يختار oral rehydration solution مع الاستمرار في age-appropriate diet. IV hydration ليست الخطوة الأولى إذا كان الطفل قادرًا على الشرب ولا توجد severe hypovolemia.
questions.reasoningEn: The source states that oral rehydration therapy is preferred for mild to moderate hypovolemia.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: BRAT diet ليست التغذية المفضلة كخطة وحيدة؛ IV fluids تُحجز عادةً للحالات الشديدة أو عند فشل/تعذر ORT.
questions.clinicalPearl: Mild to moderate dehydration: ORS is preferred when feasible.

questions.stemEn: A child develops food-poisoning symptoms two hours after eating chicken and salad. What is the most likely causative organism?
questions.explanationAr: Onset سريع جدًا خلال ساعتين بعد الطعام يوجّه إلى preformed toxin. المصدر يختار Staphylococcus aureus ويذكر أن الأعراض قد تبدأ خلال 30 دقيقة إلى 8 ساعات.
questions.reasoningEn: The very short incubation period fits preformed Staphylococcus aureus enterotoxin in the source explanation.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Campylobacter عادةً يحتاج فترة حضانة أطول ولا يفسر onset خلال ساعتين بنفس القوة.
questions.clinicalPearl: Very rapid food-poisoning onset suggests a preformed toxin.

questions.topic: Disorders of The Esophagus and Stomach
questions.stemEn: An 8-year-old child with asthma has dysphagia. An endoscopy image shows Candida esophagitis. What is the treatment?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يحدد الصورة كـCandida esophagitis ويختار Fluconazole. Acyclovir يستهدف viral esophagitis، وPPI للـacid-related disease، بينما steroid قد يزيد خطر الفطريات بدل علاجها.
questions.reasoningEn: The source identifies Candida esophagitis on endoscopy and selects fluconazole.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Acyclovir ليس antifungal؛ PPI لا يعالج Candida؛ steroid ليس العلاج المضاد للفطريات وقد يكون عامل خطورة عند الاستخدام المزمن.
questions.clinicalPearl: Candida esophagitis requires systemic antifungal therapy rather than acid suppression.

questions.topic: Disorders of The Esophagus and Stomach
questions.stemEn: An 8-year-old child with allergy and eczema has dysphagia. After two weeks of PPI, endoscopy with biopsy shows more than 15 eosinophils. What is the treatment?

options.text: Switch to another proton pump inhibitor
Continue the same proton pump inhibitor and add antibiotic

questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار steroid من الخيارات المتاحة لكنه يذكر صراحةً أن dietary elimination therapy وPPI وtopical swallowed glucocorticoids كلها ضمن first-line options، وأن trial الـPPI المعتاد أطول من أسبوعين. لذلك نحفظ مفتاح الامتحان كما هو لكن لا نعتبره verified بعد.
questions.reasoningEn: The compilation's keyed choice is steroid, while its own explanation notes that dietary therapy, PPIs, and swallowed topical glucocorticoids are first-line approaches; the short two-week PPI trial makes the recalled item imperfect.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Switching PPI أو إضافة antibiotic لا يعالجان eosinophilic inflammation كما صيغ السؤال. مع ذلك، صياغة السؤال تحتاج مراجعة لأن مدة PPI المذكورة قصيرة والمصدر نفسه يذكر خيارات first-line متعددة.
questions.clinicalPearl: EoE treatment options include dietary therapy, PPI, and swallowed topical glucocorticoids; source question is imperfect.

questions.topic: Disorders of The Esophagus and Stomach
questions.stemEn: A 3-week-old girl has progressive forceful vomiting after each feed and seems hungry after vomiting. Which radiologic imaging test do you want to request?
questions.explanationAr: Forceful nonbilious post-feed vomiting في عمر 2 أسابيع إلى 3 أشهر هو نمط hypertrophic pyloric stenosis. المصدر يختار abdominal ultrasound كـfirst imaging modality، بينما plain X-ray محدود الفائدة.
questions.reasoningEn: For a typical infantile hypertrophic pyloric stenosis presentation, the source recommends ultrasound as the first imaging modality.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Abdominal X-ray قد يظهر dilated stomach لكنه nonspecific؛ barium study ليس الاختبار الأول عند وجود صورة سريرية نموذجية وتوفر ultrasound.
questions.clinicalPearl: Suspected hypertrophic pyloric stenosis: ultrasound is first-line imaging.

questions.topic: Disorders of The Small and Large Intestine
questions.stemEn: A 2-month-old infant has abdominal pain, bilious vomiting, and constipation. An X-ray shows multiple air-fluid levels. What is the most likely cause?
questions.explanationAr: Bilious vomiting مع multiple air-fluid levels على X-ray يدعم mechanical bowel obstruction. المصدر يختار small bowel obstruction ويذكر أن التمييز في هذا السؤال مبني أساسًا على صورة الأشعة.
questions.reasoningEn: The source states that the answer is based on the radiographic findings and selects small bowel obstruction.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Large bowel obstruction قد يسبب abdominal distension وأحيانًا small-bowel dilation، لكن صورة السؤال كما جُمعت اختبرت small bowel obstruction.
questions.clinicalPearl: Bilious vomiting in an infant is an urgent obstruction clue and requires prompt evaluation.
